program_source = '''def transform(grid):
    """Propagate marked rows and columns across complete cells in the 8-grid."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_walls = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 8 for v in row)]
    col_walls = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h))]

    def ranges(size, walls):
        result = []
        start = 0
        for wall in walls:
            if start < wall:
                result.append((start, wall))
            start = wall + 1
        if start < size:
            result.append((start, size))
        return result

    all_rows = ranges(h, row_walls)
    all_cols = ranges(w, col_walls)
    row_unit = all_rows[0][1] - all_rows[0][0]
    col_unit = all_cols[0][1] - all_cols[0][0]
    row_blocks = [(a, b) for a, b in all_rows if b - a == row_unit]
    col_blocks = [(a, b) for a, b in all_cols if b - a == col_unit]
    marked_rows = set()
    marked_cols = set()
    for bi, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_blocks):
        for bj, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_blocks):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            if 3 in cells:
                marked_rows.add(bi)
            if 2 in cells:
                marked_cols.add(bj)

    for bi, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_blocks):
        for bj, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_blocks):
            color = 6 if bi in marked_rows and bj in marked_cols else (
                3 if bi in marked_rows else (2 if bj in marked_cols else None)
            )
            if color is not None:
                for r in range(r0, r1):
                    for c in range(c0, c1):
                        out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
